description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains used for testing reminder functionalities, including the ReminderTestGrain2 class and its copy, with methods managing reminders, handling activation/deactivation, and interacting with reminder registries.

classes.name: ReminderTestGrain2
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing reminder functionalities for testing purposes, including starting, stopping, and handling reminders, with persistent state management.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation; initializes reminder state and logs activation.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation; logs deactivation.

methods.name: GetReminderStates
methods.description: Returns the current state of all reminders.

methods.name: StartReminder
methods.description: Starts a reminder with specified name, period, and validation option.

methods.name: ReceiveReminder
methods.description: Handles receipt of a reminder; updates internal counters and logs.

methods.name: StopReminder
methods.description: Stops a specific reminder by name, updating its state.

methods.name: GetMissingReminders
methods.description: Fetches reminders that are missing from local cache.

methods.name: StopReminder (overload)
methods.description: Stops a reminder given its IGrainReminder reference.

methods.name: GetReminderPeriod
methods.description: Returns the period of a reminder by name.

methods.name: GetReminderDueTimeAndPeriod
methods.description: Returns the due time and period for a reminder.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Reads the current counter value from file.

methods.name: GetReminderObject
methods.description: Retrieves the reminder object for a given reminder name.

methods.name: GetRemindersList
methods.description: Returns a list of all active reminders.

methods.name: GetFileName
methods.description: Constructs filename for a given reminder based on prefix and reminder name.

methods.name: GetDefaultPeriod
methods.description: Returns the default reminder period; used for initializing reminder interval.

methods.name: EraseReminderTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table for testing.

classes.name: ReminderTestCopyGrain
classes.description: A copy implementation of ReminderTestGrain with similar reminder handling, used for testing different behaviors.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the copy grain, sets up reminder state.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Logs deactivation for cleanup.

methods.name: StartReminder
methods.description: Starts a reminder, managing internal state and files.

methods.name: ReceiveReminder
methods.description: Processes incoming reminder, updates sequence counter, logs, and file.

methods.name: StopReminder
methods.description: Stops a reminder given its name or object, updating internal state.

methods.name: GetMissingReminders
methods.description: Fetches any reminders missing from local cache.

methods.name: GetReminderPeriod
methods.description: Returns reminder period.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Reads counter value from associated file.

methods.name: GetReminderObject
methods.description: Retrieves the reminder object.

methods.name: GetRemindersList
methods.description: Provides list of active reminders.

methods.name: GetFileName
methods.description: Generates filename based on prefix and reminder name.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Logs activation.

methods.name: StartReminder
methods.description: Attempts to start a reminder, but it is designed to fail or be incorrect intentionally.

methods.description: Registers or updates a reminder for a grain.
